summary: Register optional Library events only when the engine exposes them.
details: The shared Library no longer passes absent locale-change or research-queue-move event IDs to the engine registration API. Both handlers remain active on supported modern engines.

The actual registration function is exercised with the 1.0, 1.1 and modern event sets. Tests reject unsupported IDs, retain supported research, translation and player handlers, and reproduce the predecessor failure.
Historical Library remains disabled. Event guards do not supply older-engine locale identity or locale invalidation, and do not qualify historical GUI, save or multiplayer behavior.
